name: MCP Client & AI Workflow Automation
author: miniOrange

sections.description:
miniOrange AI Agent is an MCP (Model Context Protocol) Client for WordPress that helps organizations connect AI agents with enterprise applications, business systems, and WordPress data using a single workflow platform.

Build AI-powered automations that connect WordPress, WooCommerce, Salesforce, SharePoint, HubSpot, Slack, Jira, Stripe, GitHub, Zendesk, Notion, Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, and any MCP-compatible service. Use your preferred AI model and create workflows that can retrieve information, reason over data, execute actions, and synchronize systems.

Why MCP?

Model Context Protocol (MCP) is becoming the standard way for AI agents to interact with tools, applications, APIs, and business systems.

Instead of creating custom integrations for every application, MCP provides a consistent interface that allows AI agents to discover tools and perform actions across multiple platforms.

miniOrange AI Agent acts as an MCP Client for WordPress, allowing you to connect to enterprise systems and orchestrate AI-powered workflows from a central location.

Key Features

  • Connect any MCP-compatible service.
  • Bring your own LLM provider.
  • AI-powered workflow automation.
  • Event-driven and scheduled workflows.
  • Prompt-based workflow sequencing.
  • AI chatbot for WordPress and connected systems.
  • WordPress management tools.
  • WooCommerce automation.
  • Enterprise integrations.
  • Multiple authentication methods.

Supported Enterprise Platforms

miniOrange AI Agent is designed to work with enterprise applications that support MCP, including:

  • Salesforce
  • SharePoint
  • HubSpot
  • Slack
  • Jira
  • Stripe
  • GitHub
  • Zendesk
  • Notion
  • Microsoft 365
  • Google Workspace
  • Dropbox
  • Box
  • Asana
  • Linear
  • Figma

You can also connect custom and private MCP servers.

Popular Automation Templates

Salesforce + WooCommerce

  • Create Salesforce leads when WooCommerce orders are placed.
  • Create opportunities from purchases.
  • Synchronize product catalogs.
  • Update customer information automatically.

SharePoint + WordPress

  • Create WordPress posts from SharePoint documents.
  • Publish knowledge-base content automatically.
  • Monitor document libraries.
  • Synchronize content between systems.

HubSpot + WordPress

  • Create HubSpot contacts from WordPress registrations.
  • Synchronize customer records.
  • Trigger marketing workflows.
  • Update CRM data automatically.

Slack + WordPress

  • Send notifications for new orders.
  • Alert teams about new registrations.
  • Notify users about workflow results.
  • Share reports automatically.

AI Agent Workflows

Workflows are built using prompt-based reasoning and sequential actions.

AI agents can:

  • Analyze incoming information.
  • Determine next actions.
  • Execute MCP tools.
  • Update enterprise systems.
  • Create WordPress content.
  • Synchronize data between platforms.

Workflows can be configured for simple automations or multi-step business processes.

Event-Driven Automation

Trigger workflows instantly when events occur.

Examples include:

  • WooCommerce orders.
  • Customer registrations.
  • Product updates.
  • Content publishing.
  • User updates.
  • Business application events.

Additional triggers and workflow actions are continuously being added as the platform evolves.

Scheduled Automation

Run workflows automatically on a schedule.

Examples:

  • Daily Salesforce synchronization.
  • Weekly CRM updates.
  • Product catalog synchronization.
  • Content publishing.
  • Business reporting.
  • Compliance checks.

Salesforce Automation

Use Salesforce MCP servers to automate CRM operations.

Examples:

  • Lead creation.
  • Opportunity creation.
  • Contact management.
  • Product synchronization.
  • Customer lifecycle updates.
  • Sales workflow automation.

SharePoint Automation

Connect SharePoint document libraries and business content.

Examples:

  • Create WordPress posts from uploaded files.
  • Generate announcements from documents.
  • Synchronize content repositories.
  • Build AI-powered knowledge workflows.

HubSpot Automation

Automate marketing and customer relationship workflows.

Examples:

  • Contact synchronization.
  • Lead management.
  • Customer updates.
  • Marketing workflow orchestration.
  • Cross-platform customer engagement.

WordPress & WooCommerce Tools

miniOrange AI Agent extends WordPress with AI-accessible tools.

AI agents can:

  • Create posts.
  • Update posts.
  • Create pages.
  • Manage custom post types.
  • Create taxonomies.
  • Manage users.
  • Manage media.
  • Create WooCommerce products.
  • Update WooCommerce products.
  • Manage WooCommerce orders.

AI Chatbot

The built-in chatbot can interact with WordPress and connected MCP services.

Examples:

  • Ask questions about Salesforce data.
  • Search SharePoint content.
  • Retrieve HubSpot contacts.
  • Analyze WooCommerce orders.
  • Generate reports.
  • Execute actions through connected MCP tools.

The chatbot can be used in administrative environments and customer-facing experiences.

Bring Your Own LLM

Use the AI provider that best fits your organization.

Supported options include:

  • OpenAI
  • Claude
  • Gemini
  • Ollama
  • Self-hosted models
  • OpenAI-compatible providers

Different models can be configured for different MCP connections and workflows.

Authentication & Security

miniOrange AI Agent supports enterprise authentication requirements.

Examples include:

  • OAuth
  • API Keys
  • Bearer Tokens
  • Custom Authentication Methods

This allows organizations to securely connect AI agents with enterprise applications.

Future Expansion

The MCP ecosystem is evolving rapidly.

miniOrange AI Agent is designed to support additional triggers, workflow actions, enterprise integrations, and automation capabilities as new MCP-compatible services become available.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Configure your preferred AI provider.
  3. Connect one or more MCP-compatible services.
  4. Create workflows and automations.
  5. Start using the AI chatbot and automation tools.
sections.faq:
What is MCP?

Model Context Protocol (MCP) is a standard that enables AI agents to interact with external tools, services, and business applications.

What is an MCP Client?

An MCP Client connects AI agents to MCP-compatible services and allows them to discover tools and perform actions.

Can I connect Salesforce to WordPress?

Yes. Connect Salesforce through MCP and automate lead creation, opportunity management, customer synchronization, and CRM workflows.

Can I connect SharePoint to WordPress?

Yes. Connect SharePoint document libraries and build content automation workflows.

Can I connect HubSpot to WordPress?

Yes. Synchronize contacts, leads, and customer information.

Does the plugin support WooCommerce?

Yes. Automate WooCommerce products, orders, and customer workflows.

Which AI models are supported?

OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, Ollama, self-hosted models, and OpenAI-compatible providers.

Can I use different AI models for different workflows?

Yes.

Can I schedule workflows?

Yes. Workflows can run automatically on schedules.

Can I trigger workflows from events?

Yes. Event-driven automation is supported.

Can I connect multiple MCP servers?

Yes.

Can the chatbot execute actions?

Yes. Depending on permissions and connected tools, the chatbot can perform actions.

Can I manage WordPress content through AI agents?

Yes. AI agents can create and update content using WordPress tools.

Does the plugin support enterprise authentication methods?

Yes. Multiple authentication mechanisms are supported.

Can I connect custom MCP servers?

Yes. Any MCP-compatible service can be connected.
sections.changelog:
1.2.2

  • Updated support widget
  • Updated documentation links
  • Bug fixes

1.2.1

  • Modified the Tools While Creating/Editing the AI Agents
  • Handled the flow while testing the agent if no abilities and knowledge is configured
  • Added Support form and Feedback form

1.2.0

  • Enhanced AI Chat interface with support for multiple chat sessions and persistent chat history.
  • Added a Stop button to instantly cancel ongoing AI responses.
  • Introduced Copy and Regenerate actions for every AI-generated response.
  • Create and manage unlimited AI agents, each with its own system prompt, AI model, and WordPress role permissions.
  • Assign WordPress abilities and MCP tools to individual AI agents.
  • Improved system prompt management with a clean read-only view and inline editing option.
  • Added agent-level role-based access control for secure and controlled AI interactions.
  • Implemented comprehensive execution logs to track all AI agent activities and actions.

1.1.1

  • List all the abilities in the WordPress Site and added Abilities Governance
  • Removed dependency of AI Client Plugin
  • Create new pipelines to link multiple Abilities

1.1.0

  • Added support for Connecting with AI Agents like ChatGPT and Claude.AI
  • Displaying the Execution Logs of the AI Agent Chat

1.0.0

  • Initial release
  • Chatbot with Abilities API integration: Create Post and Get Site URL.
